usageNotes: Use this endpoint to discover which VM-specific CPU flags are available on a given node before configuring a guest's CPU options. The response includes a 'supported-on' list per flag so you can verify cluster-wide compatibility before live-migrating a VM with custom flags. Always pass 'arch=aarch64' explicitly when targeting ARM nodes — the endpoint returns an empty list for aarch64 since no VM-specific flags are currently defined for that architecture.

examples.summary: List available KVM CPU flags on an x86_64 node

tips: Omitting 'arch' defaults to the host's native architecture — always specify it explicitly in mixed-arch clusters to avoid ambiguous results.
The 'supported-on' array in each flag entry tells you which cluster nodes support that flag under the chosen acceleration type, making it useful for pre-migration compatibility checks.
Use 'accel=tcg' to check flag availability when KVM hardware virtualization is not present (e.g., nested virtualization or non-KVM hosts).
This endpoint requires no special privilege beyond a valid Proxmox session ('user: all'), so it is safe to expose to read-only API tokens.
